description: This file contains unit tests for the DataGroupDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods related to data group permissions and retrievals, ensuring correct behavior for various scenarios.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing DataGroupDao functionalities, including permission checks and data retrieval methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, including loading fixtures and initializing the DAO.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Tests retrieving data group permissions and verifies the count and read permission.

methods.name: testGetDataGroups
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all data groups, expecting 4 entries.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupsNoneDefined
methods.description: Tests scenario when no data groups are defined, expecting zero entries.

methods.name: testGetDataGroup
methods.description: Tests retrieval of specific data groups by key and verifies their attributes.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupInvalid
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a non-existent data group, expecting null.
